facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation circulated the draft Cybersecurity Bill 2026 for stakeholder review in August 2026, and opened a second two-day consultation workshop on it in Maseru on 2026-09-23 with the Lesotho Communications Authority and UNDP, as the Department of Information reports.

systems.country_label: Multi-stakeholder forum launched July 2026 (public, private, academia, civil society, technical community); no opinion on a named law stated here
Bill split from the 2024 Computer Crime and Cybersecurity Bill
